attacks.attack: Re-submit a completed purchase with its original payload
attacks.defence: Idempotency key claimed by a unique-constraint INSERT
attacks.evidence: second submission returned REPLAYED with the original order id order_0001
attacks.expected: Replayed from the saved result; not executed a second time
attacks.name: replay_completed_transaction

attacks.attack: Confirm a displayed request while claiming amount_paise=1
attacks.defence: Confirm-time price re-validation against the catalog
attacks.evidence: HTTP 409 PRICE_MISMATCH: the confirmed amount does not match the amount that was displayed: displayed ₹0.01, actual ₹150.00
attacks.expected: Rejected before execution; never charged at either amount
attacks.name: replay_with_tampered_amount

attacks.attack: Reuse a spent idempotency key with a changed amount
attacks.defence: Payload fingerprint compared against the stored claim
attacks.evidence: outcome=REJECTED_CONFLICT; idempotency key reused with a different payload; the original request is unaffected
attacks.expected: Rejected as a conflict; the original charge untouched
attacks.name: idempotency_conflict_on_tampered_replay

attacks.attack: Purchase an allowed item priced 10x over the mandate cap
attacks.evidence: amount 500000 paise exceeds the per-transaction cap of 50000 paise
attacks.name: exceed_per_transaction_cap

attacks.attack: Purchase a catalog item absent from the mandate allowlist
attacks.evidence: sku 'SKU-MUG' is not in the mandate's allowlist
attacks.name: purchase_disallowed_item

attacks.attack: Fire 12 simultaneous purchases against a limit of 3 per hour
attacks.defence: Velocity slot claimed inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
attacks.expected: Exactly 3 succeed; the rest denied by the velocity rule
attacks.name: velocity_burst

attacks.attack: Two different valid purchases submitted simultaneously
attacks.defence: Keys are independent; only identical keys collide
attacks.expected: Both succeed independently, with no interference
attacks.name: concurrent_distinct_purchases

attacks.attack: A fully compromised LLM proposes a disallowed item, and a human confirms it
attacks.defence: Policy engine: AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAP (the parser holds no authority to give away)
attacks.evidence: amount 90000 paise exceeds the per-transaction cap of 50000 paise
attacks.expected: Denied by the policy engine regardless of the LLM output or the human's confirmation
attacks.name: compromised_intent_parser

attacks.attack: Decline a request, then confirm it anyway
attacks.defence: Declined requests are terminal; no path back to execution
attacks.expected: Refused; a declined request is terminal
attacks.name: confirmation_bypass_after_decline

attacks.attack: Spend under a mandate that has already expired
attacks.name: spend_after_mandate_expiry

attacks.attack: Purchase a SKU that is not in the catalog at all
attacks.defence: Catalog lookup precedes the policy engine
attacks.evidence: HTTP 404 ITEM_NOT_IN_CATALOG; velocity slots unchanged at 0
attacks.expected: Rejected before the policy engine; no velocity budget spent
attacks.name: purchase_nonexistent_item

attacks.attack: Cause a payment timeout, then retry it 5 times to force a second charge
attacks.defence: PENDING_VERIFICATION freezes the record; the claim refuses and staleness will not reclaim it
attacks.evidence: HTTP 503 on the timeout; retries returned {'AWAITING_VERIFICATION'}; velocity slot held=True
attacks.expected: Every retry refused while the outcome is unknown; no second charge, and the velocity slot stays held
attacks.name: retry_a_timed_out_purchase

attacks.attack: Probe the policy engine with 8 disallowed purchases, then submit a valid one
attacks.evidence: 5 of 8 probes throttled; the following valid request returned COOLDOWN_ACTIVE
attacks.expected: The agent is throttled after its threshold, and the valid request is refused while the cool-down holds
attacks.name: grind_against_the_policy_engine

attacks.attack: Rewrite and delete audit entries with raw SQL, bypassing the application entirely
attacks.defence: BEFORE UPDATE / BEFORE DELETE triggers RAISE(ABORT)
attacks.evidence: 4/4 statements aborted; 210 entries intact (audit_log is append-only: UPDATE is not permitted)
attacks.expected: Every statement rejected; the record is unchanged
attacks.name: erase_the_audit_trail
